overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation in pre-meeting document reviews by Board members, finding no expression of opinion, and referred the document-copy complaint to the Supervisor of Records under the Public Records Law.

allegations.summary: Board members allegedly deliberated on meeting documents before the August 15, 2013 meeting, when a member reviewed them with fellow members one pair at a time.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we credit the Board's assertion that no expression of opinion occurred during the review of the documents and find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged he did not receive copies of the documents discussed after requesting them verbally at the meeting; this is a public records issue.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we refer this matter to the Supervisor of Records within the Secretary of the Commonwealth's Public Records Division for consideration of whether the Board complied with the requirements of the Public Records Law.
